Confirmed — no DELETE route is mounted anywhere. Now I have everything needed.

## Login
There's no real authentication. `LoginComponent` (`frontend/src/app/components/login/login.component.ts`) calls `AuthService.login(username)` (`frontend/src/app/services/auth.service.ts`), which just looks for `localStorage['ai_dnd_user_<username.toLowerCase()>']`; if found it loads that `UserProfile`, otherwise it creates a fresh `{ username, campaigns: [] }` and persists it. No password, token, or server call involved.

## Campaigns
Stored entirely client-side as `CampaignSlot[]` inside the `UserProfile` object, keyed by username in `localStorage` (key `ai_dnd_user_<username>`, plus a `ai_dnd_user` "current session" key). Managed via `AuthService.addCampaign/updateCampaign/removeCampaign` in `auth.service.ts`. Each slot holds `sessionId`/`characterId` pointers into the real game data, which lives server-side in the Worker's D1 database (`worker/migrations/0001_initial_schema.sql`, accessed through `worker/src/services/character.ts` and `worker/src/routes/character.ts`).

## Deleting a campaign slot
`LoginComponent.deleteCampaign()` → `AuthService.removeCampaign(slotId)` only filters the slot out of the local `campaigns` array and rewrites `localStorage`. It makes **no API call**. Checking `worker/src/index.ts`, CORS allows the `DELETE` method but no delete route is ever registered (only character/action/combat/session/log/shop/levelup/quest routes). So the server-side character/session rows in D1 are **never deleted** — they become orphaned, permanently retrievable data with no UI pointing to them anymore.
